questions.stem: A Rh negative woman has received anti D 28 weeks. What would be done for now

options.label: A
options.text: Give 300 mcg with 72 hr of delivery irrespective of baby blood group

options.label: B
options.text: No need for further dose of anti D

options.label: C
options.text: Give 300 mcg within 72 hrs of delivery if baby blood group is positive

options.label: D
options.text: Give another dose in next pregnancy
